arguments.summary: Triage is complete. Questions 1–4 were answered by their assigned specialists; question 5 was answered by reuse of the completed macro task; question 6 was approved because filing evidence may materially quantify issuer geopolitical exposure and is now assigned to task-8. No additional proposed questions remain to route. Current evidence still leaves valuation, macro-policy, and geopolitical exposure gaps unresolved.

claims.text: The company, macro, technical, and geopolitics assignments (questions 1–4) are completed; the technical-to-macro follow-up (question 5) was answered by the completed macro task, while the issuer-disclosure follow-up (question 6) is accepted and pending company research.

Question 6 has the highest remaining marginal information value because quantified issuer cross-border revenue, export-control, or supply-chain disclosures could narrow a currently unquantified policy-risk channel for four companies and QQQ look-through.

gaps.description: Pending answer to question 6: latest issuer filing disclosures have not yet been assessed for quantified cross-border revenue, export-control restrictions, or supply-chain concentration.
No current market-derived company valuation multiples or supported forward earnings inputs are available for scenario valuation of ANET, MU, META, or NVDA.
The QQQ holdings snapshot is dated 2026-09-12 and marked stale, leaving current look-through weights unresolved.
Current policy-rate, Treasury-yield, credit-spread, and substantive FOMC-release contents were not available in returned macro evidence.

assumptions: No further follow-up is approved unless it can resolve a material assessment blocker within the final-synthesis reserve.
Completed-session technical observations remain descriptive rather than forecasts.
arguments.counter_thesis: The pending issuer-disclosure review could find limited or immaterial quantified geopolitical exposure, while reported profitability and technical strength could remain more relevant near-term than the currently unresolved macro and policy channels.

review_conditions.description: Reassess the watchlist after task-8 returns the issuer-filing disclosure review and before resolving geopolitical transmission assumptions.

shared_exposures.mechanism: A common macro discount-rate/risk-appetite channel and a candidate technology/policy channel remain relevant research considerations; QQQ has dated overlap with NVDA, MU, and META.
shared_exposures.qualification: Macro stance and current QQQ weights are unresolved, and issuer-specific policy exposure awaits task-8; this is not a quantified common exposure.
